title: Enterprise evidence boarding ops and onboarding windows playbook
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create an operational playbook and milestone orchestration for enterprise customers onboarding to Redwood's compliance surface (SOC2/ISO controls, SSO/SAML, tenant-scoped audit logs). This ticket defines the evidence-boarding flow (how customer artifacts are ingested/staged), safe onboarding windows, owner rotations, and fallbacks to a constrained-hosted path for customers who cannot complete all gates in one wave. The goal is to reduce onboarding time-to-complete from discovery to audit-ready by 40% while preserving evidence integrity and traceability.
acceptance_criteria: Runbook drafted and reviewed by Security, Infra, and Solutions Engineering
Onboarding windows and blackout policy documented with timezone-aware scheduler
Automation tasks for evidence ingestion (S3/Drive connectors) enumerated with sample configs
Canary plan for first 5 pilot tenants with rollback and fallback behaviors
Dashboards linked for evidence velocity, missing-evidence alerts, and audit log delivery SLOs
risks: Customers with strict network controls may block evidence ingestion (mitigation: manual upload workflow)
KMS/HSM key onboarding complexity causes delays (mitigation: prescriptive checklist + dedicated SE slot)
Large tenants may exceed retention quotas unexpectedly (mitigation: preflight retention calculator)
SAML metadata heterogeneity can fail automated validation (mitigation: sample metadata library and validation tool)
Tight onboarding windows may clash with customer maintenance windows (mitigation: flexible windowing and owner swaps)

runbook_highlights: Evidence boarding phases: intake -> validation -> verification -> archival
Onboarding window rules: default 2 business days, extendable by SEs, blackout list support
Fallback modes: Hosted-constrained mode (limited retention) and Manual-only path
Owner rotation: 48-hour handoff protocol with explicit acceptance in ticket
Audit trace: every boarding record must include uploader, checksum, evidence type, and retention policy
